Evidence: Treaty 6 Medicine Chest, Provincial Healthcare Bans, Indigenous Sovereignty
#Aletheia #SaddleLake #AbLeg

Saddle Lake Cree Nation claims its Treaty 6 sovereignty allows it to bypass Alberta's gender-affirming care bans, establishing virtual health hubs to protect youth.
